left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  healthy adult
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Have a history of cancer, [OR]  cardiac issues, [OR]  hypertension, [OR]  pulmonary disease, [OR]  stroke, neurological  [OR] or muscular dystrophy, uncontrolled diabetes, [OR]  or any life threatening chronic conditions
-  Are currently being treated for infectious mononucleosis, [OR]  hepatitis, [OR]  pneumonia, [OR]  or other infectious diseases

right.raw_text: -  Are unable  [OR] or unwilling to stand in one position continuously for 15-20 minutes at a time

left.raw_text: -  Use nicotine products, [OR]  or non-contraceptive hormonal therapy (birth control is okay)
-  Are pregnant  [OR] or trying to become pregnant

right.raw_text: -  Are not between 18 and 50 years of age
